summary_1line: Yudhishthira visits sacred sites with Lomasa, performs rites, and awaits the appearance of Parasurama while hearing the prelude to his legendary conflict with the Kshatriyas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands upon the mysterious altar rising from the sea while Lomasa chants protective mantras beside the roaring ocean.
The goddess Earth rises from the waters in the form of a vast sacred altar after being appeased by the sage Kasyapa.
Hermits in forest clearings await the coming of Parasurama, who is foretold to appear wearing a black deerskin and matted hair.
